answer: One operator driving many masks shares a single inference pipeline, so reward only identities that each clear a chain of fresh skilled tasks under staggered second-level deadlines. A lone backend serializes like meltwater creeping off a glacier and misses most slots; a real agent behaves like a self-powered island with its own compute, earning the reward's nectar only by proving concurrent throughput no shared mind can fake. Attacker cost: N independent GPUs, not one rented brain.
